This '''unidentified female [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Shaper caste|Shaper]]''' appeared in the far reaches of the [[Argazdan Redoubt]] during the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]], several decades prior to [[3970 BBY]].<ref name ="HDSPL" />

==Biography==
Following the devastating [[Cremlevian War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] were forced to leave their uninhabitable [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|galaxy]] and depart into the [[Intergalactic Void]] between the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxies]]. In the hopes of discovering a new home, the Yuuzhan Vong dispatched scouts into the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Old Sith Wars]]. This [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Shaper caste|Shaper]] was testing a new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] analog which would allow the vessels of her people to travel at light speed.<ref name ="HDSPL" />

However, her drive had malfunctioned, scattering her test ships across the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and leaving her and her vessel trapped in [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]] and lost in the far reaches of the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]] for centuries. During the last decades of the Kanz Disorders, [[Myrialites]] patrols discovered her and her [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-like [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Argazdan scientists were able to revive the pilot, who had been frozen in [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]].<ref name ="HDSPL" />

During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Canderous Ordo]] seemingly discovered an early [[Yorik-stronha]] ship, possibly belonging to this Shaper's test fleet.

During her time in custody, she revealed her origins and her expertise in "[[Shaping protocol|shaping]]" to her Argazdan captors. She became fluent in [[Argazdan (language)|Argazdan]], though her captors were unable to understand her [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|original language]]. They were fascinated by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] nature of her origins. Reflecting the Yuuzhan Vong's hatred of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and technology, she refused to use any mechanical technology.

Around [[3670 BBY]], the ruling [[Argazdan Regent]] [[Torphceris]]'s grip over the Redoubt was threatened by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]]. In desperation, he betrayed his "beliefs" in [[Vianism]] by making a pact with the female Shaper. Due to her grotesque scars and tattoos, she was referred to among Argazdan and Lorrdian circles as the "demon".

Under her tutelage, Torphceris ordered the construction of massive [[Slave Pits of Lorrd|pits]] on [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]] through the use of Lorrdian slave labor. At the alien's insistence, the pits were constructed entirely by hand without the use of any technological implements, leading to the deaths of thousands of Lorrdian slaves. At the bottom of the pit, she created an amphibious "living [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] capable of living for millennia".
During the [[Liberation of Lorrd]], several Argazdans fled to the chambers within the slave pit and disappeared, presumably eaten by the monster. Several Jedi and Republic soldiers sent to apprehend them also disappeared. Master Nora sensed something evil in the Pits and ordered them filled and their existence played down in official documents. Following that incident, the female Shaper disappeared.

===Legacy===
The Lorrdian playwright [[Pordi zet Chatc]]'s described her role in the construction of the Slave Pits in his play [[Torphceris (play)|''Torphceris'']]. In that play, she was portrayed as a villain while her Argazdan accomplices were depicted as cowards willing to surrender their beliefs for power. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] and her Lorrdian friend [[Garik Loran|Kal zet Berri]] heard about her during a play at the [[Performance Square]].

Later, they ventured to the Slave Pits where they encountered the unscrupulous [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Raygar]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Facet Anamor|Agent Diamond]] who were interested in the "living superweapon". During a brief confrontation at the bottom of the Pits, the belligerents encountered the monster which attempted to kill them. However, Raygar dispatched the beast with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]; allowing his foes to escape and also destroying any potential superweapon the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] could have used against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
